Description: Tests if JSON array at specified path contains expected element
Tests if JSON file contains specified key path (supports dot notation like "user.profile.name")
Tests the number of JSON values at a key path (optionally only those matching a value)
Parameters: dst (str), key_path (str), expected_count (int), expected_value* (str/int/float/bool), regex_match* (bool), comparison_type* (str), encoding* (str)

Description: Tests if JSON value at key path matches expected value using placeholders (supports wildcards [*] and * with any/all modes)
Parameters: dst (str), key_path (str), expected_value (str/int/float/bool), regex_match* (bool), wildcard_mode* (str), encoding* (str)
